description:
一座可交互的水彩锦鲤池塘。你忙别的时候它一直在动：光、颜色、天气和小生物都跟着你真实的时刻与季节走。

[h2]它有什么[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]四季池塘:[/b]底图跟着真实月份换景（春·蝌蚪与小雨 / 夏·荷塘蛙鸣蜻蜓·阵雨雷电 / 秋 / 冬·冰湖裂缝落雪），也可以在设置里手动锁住一季；换季是柔和的交叉溶解。
[*] [b]真实日光:[/b]光的方向、颜色和亮度跟着你的真实时钟——正午明亮、黄昏偏暖、夜里偏冷偏暗，池塘和桌面上的时间是一致的。
[*] [b]时钟与农历:[/b]右上角有时钟、公历日期、农历与节气，冬季字顶还会积雪。
[*] [b]可互动:[/b]点击水面投食，鱼会围过来吃；鱼会躲开凑太近的光标。冬天湖面结冰，鱼潜到冰下——点击改玩雪：撒雪、积雪堆、连点几次还能堆出雪人。
[*] [b]省电:[/b]帧率上限可在设置里调低；时钟支持手动显隐。
[/list]

[h2]设置[/h2]
[list]
[*] 季节:自动(按真实月份) / 春 / 夏 / 秋 / 冬
[*] 锦鲤数量（10–200）
[*] 帧率上限
[*] 光随时间走（关=恒定白天）
[*] 显示时钟
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]English[/h2]
A hand-painted watercolor koi pond that keeps living while you work: light, weather and little creatures follow your real clock and the real season.

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Four seasons:[/b] the pond follows the real month (spring - tadpoles & light rain / summer - lotus, frogs, dragonflies, showers & lightning / autumn / winter - frozen lake, ice cracks, snow), or lock a season in the settings; seasons cross-fade softly.
[*] [b]Real daylight:[/b] light direction, colour and brightness track your actual clock - bright at noon, warm at dusk, cool and dim at night.
[*] [b]Clock & lunar calendar:[/b] time, date, lunar date and solar terms in the corner; snow piles up on the digits in winter.
[*] [b]Interactive:[/b] click the water to drop food and fish gather; they shy away from a close cursor. In winter the lake freezes - clicking plays with snow instead: scatter snow, build piles, and stack a snowman with a few more clicks.
[*] [b]Light on your PC:[/b] adjustable FPS cap; the clock widget can be hidden.
[/list]

[h2]Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*] Season: automatic (by real month) / spring / summer / autumn / winter
[*] Number of koi (10-200)
[*] FPS cap
[*] Light follows real time (off = always daytime)
[*] Show clock
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[i]静下来,看看水。/ Sit back and watch the water.[/i]
title: 锦鲤池塘 (Koi Pond)
